notes:
Summary: Conversify builds a cloud telephony + CRM routing layer used by 600+ call centers (outsourcers + enterprise). Primary need: automated post-call summaries for QA and agent coaching plus ticket creation. High priority around reliability during marketing peaks (holiday spikes) and strict EU/UK residency for some customers. Pricing sensitivity but willing to pay for SLA-backed latency and on-prem KMS.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-02-10: Intro meeting (AE Maya Chen). Conversify: 50k calls/day peak, typical spike to 80k/day during promos. Wants p95 summary generation < 400ms for short calls, < 1200ms for long calls; batch-friendly but low-latency for supervisor workflows.
- 2026-02-25: Deep-dive w/SE Rafael Ortiz (Fireflies ff-2026-02-25-7890). Discussed Genesys integration, real-time partial-summary streaming, function-calls to ticketing system. Asked about token-cost predictability and batching controls.
- 2026-03-03: Security orientation with infra lead + legal (ff-2026-03-03-8011). Requested SOC2 Type II evidence, KMS integration diagram, and retention controls. Raised concern: recordings include cardholder fragments -> PCI redaction mandatory.
- 2026-03-12: Demo of Hosted API baseline for 2 sample calls; customer requested Dedicated/Private pricing and POC plan.

Use-case details / requirements (shorthand):
- Workloads: continuous stream of calls; post-call summary job triggered at end-of-call + optional real-time partial summaries during call for supervisor assist.
- Throughput target: sustained 1,200 concurrent post-call summary jobs/hr, burst to 8,000/hr for 2–3 hours during promos.
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 200ms (short calls), p95 < 400ms (short), p95 < 1200ms (long calls).
- Accuracy: QA threshold 85% helpfulness vs. human baseline for coaching highlights. Need eval harness.
- Integrations: Genesys CTI, internal ticketing (homegrown), SSO via SAML, KMS for key wrapping.
- Safety: automatic PCI redaction + configurable PII masks; must be able to run in VPC or on-prem air-gapped for some EU customers.
- Routing / fallback: want automatic fallback from dedicated -> hosted in disasters, but with tenancy isolation.

Sample post-call summary snippet (from demo call):
- Transcript (trimmed): "Agent: Thanks for calling Acme Billing, I can see the charge — I will issue a refund for $42.16, you should see it within 3–5 business days."
- Redwood-style suggested TL;DR: "Issue: Unexpected charge on invoice 45321. Resolution: Agent issued $42.16 refund; ETA 3–5 business days. Next step: Customer follow-up if refund not posted by day 6."
- QA note (human): Good identification of invoice and proactive refund. Coaching: remind to verify last 4 of card before issuing refund (missed once).

POC asks / deliverables requested by Conversify:
- 48-hour stress sim with 10x normal burst and real call audio samples (Rafael to send sample set).
- End-to-end latency + cost report per 10k calls for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
- Integration runbook for Genesys + sample function-call hook for ticket creation.
- SOC2 artifacts + KMS integration diagram for legal review.

Open questions / internal notes:
- AE: price sensitivity but ARR goal is achievable if SLA + residency met.
- SE: need to design streaming partial-summary so supervisors can jump in mid-call. Consider KV-cache reuse for multi-turn summarization.
- Legal: draft data residency clause for EU customers.

Stated quote from Head of Ops (call 2026-02-25): "We need summaries that our QA team trusts — not bloated verbatim dumps. Speed matters when supervisors are triaging live calls."

Next meeting: week of 2026-03-22 — plan: kickoff POC run with engineering + security.
